standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 目标等效 batch。填写 0 表示关闭；填写后会优先通过梯度累积去逼近该等效 batch，而不是直接抬高单步 batch。通常先调这个，再考虑更重的兜底项

advanced_en.principle: Target effective batch. 0 disables it; when set, gradient accumulation is preferred to approach the effective batch instead of raising the per-step batch directly. Usually tune this first before reaching for the heavier fallbacks.
